name: IndicCorp v2 (AI4Bharat), Malayalam and English
licence: CC0 1.0 claimed for the dataset ("All the datasets created as part of this work will be released under a CC-0 license"); the underlying text is crawled news articles whose copyright stays with the publishers.
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/IndicCorpV2 (README, License); https://github.com/AI4Bharat/IndicBERT#license; paper arXiv:2212.05409 (Ethics Statement; news websites as primary sources).
attribution: IndicCorp v2 by AI4Bharat (Doddapaneni et al., 2023).
verdict_reason: AI4Bharat can waive only its own rights in the compilation; the news text belongs to the publishers, so it can't go into weights we ship. A small held-out sample is useful to measure the LM on non-Wikipedia Malayalam and English.
used_for: M3b only: a few thousand held-out sentences per language for LM evaluation. Never trained on, never shipped.
notes: ml.txt and en.txt are multi-GB files, over the 50 MB limit for this audit. IndicCorp v1 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) is rejected.
